newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR SPAIN V YUGOSLAVIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR SPAIN V YUGOSLAVIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for World Cup European group six qualifier between Spain and Yugoslavia on Saturday:

Spain - 1-Andoni Zubizarreta, 2-Abelardo Fernandez, 3-Sergi Barjuan, 4-Rafael Alkorta, 5-Miguel Angel Nadal, 6-Roberto Rios, 7-Josep Guardiola, 8-Luis Enrique Martinez, 9-Kiko Narvaez, 10-Raul Alfonso, 11-Alfonso Perez

Yugoslavia - 1-Kocic Aleksandar, 2-Risto Vidakovic, 3-Goran Djorovic, 4-Slavisa Jokanovic, 5-Miroslav Djukic, 6-Branko Brnovic, 7-Vladimir Jugovic, 8-Dejan Savicevic, 9-Predrag Mijatovic, 10-Dragan Stojkovic, 11-Nisa Savlejic
